'''Woir Ur'naght''' was a [[Near-Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Rishi]], Ur'naght sold gear to fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knights in [[Raider's Cove]], a port [[City/Legends|city]] on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. Ur'naght resembled a typical [[Human/Legends|Human]] with fair skin, but had solid [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Woir Ur'naght appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'', a [[2014]] Digital Expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as the Level 60 Basic Gear vendor on Rishi for the Jedi Knight class His character model uses the solid red eyes that are reserved for NPCs of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Ur'naght and the rest of the class gear vendors at Rishi, along with all other Daily Areas and high-level planets, were replaced by a single standardized vendor in Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]]; Ur'naght was replaced by Master [[Vikto]].<ref name="TOR" />
